description: Two side-by-side nested outlines (a header item plus two sub-items each), separated by a 10pt gutter -- below assemble.rs's 18pt MIN_CUT_FRACTION threshold for a 600pt-wide page. With no qualifying cut, the naive top-to-bottom/left-to-right fallback interleaves the two outlines row by row, so the second outline's header is read before the first outline's own sub-items -- collapsing each list's internal hierarchy into a single flat, incorrectly ordered sequence.
